actions: Read frozen helper/current public APIs/build records, original stdout/report/completion and bounded log bytes; recomputed hashes, parsed reports, compared Git blobs and APK ZIP payloads. No helper/production/source edit, build, ADB, VM or GitHub action. Wrote only this interim JSON.

source_notes: ThemeYaml.parser and ThemeDslExpander expand actual APK asset; Theme decoding and ThemeScope/ColorManager public APIs execute, not JVM fake parser.

Keyboard(selfConfig=null) and Key do not request labels/actions; q and constructed Keyboard_letter are nonmodifier/nonsticky. The latter is explicitly a synthetic functional TextKey using real preset/bgn/tgn aliases.

Normal/off/pressed/on six-state oracle rechecked against unchanged Key.appearanceType/getBackgroundDrawable/getTextColor. Functional off with explicit bgn missing deliberately uses generic key_back_color, not off_key_back_color.

Same two Key object identities are preserved across47 activations/46 schemes and final default revisit. Expected background comparison uses Canvas ColorDrawable pixels to handle alpha premultiplication.
Main-thread Runnable catches exceptions internally. Final baseline invariant assertion runs on Instrumentation thread and is serialized, not an app uncaught FATAL.
20s main-task and120s overall bounds; bounded fixture/report/image dimensions. No Activity navigation, UiAutomation or InputDispatcher.
helper_review.runtime_preconditions: 46-scheme asset and Keyboard_letter/q fixture assumptions matched actual runtime asset. App preferences initialized and own app-external image path writable in this run. Hard timeout/process kill could still prevent finally cleanup in a different run.

baseline.classification: Expected captured helper assertion after reproducing missing-alias transparent drawables; not product FATAL and not a passing product run.

installed_identity.test_apk_is_separate: voice-build1 main APK is incidental helper compile output and is not the baseline tested target.

old_vs_current_base_causality.why_valid_for_narrow_theme_causality: Complete old→current-base Git diff changes only manifest package visibility and toolbar action-state guard. Neither is called by this no-window/no-toolbar theme/Key object probe; all theme parsing/color/drawable/Key/Keyboard inputs are byte-identical. Thus old a047 proves the pre-fix theme behavior, subject to fixed-run same-asset/API evidence.
old_vs_current_base_causality.not_claimed: This is not a runtime test of the latest7fed whole application, full IME, toolbar or voice interaction. Full-app state and unrelated changes are not controlled by the old baseline.

cleanup_and_preferences.exact_limitation: Preference XML is not byte-identical: absent normal_mode_color/follow_system_day_night keys were materialized as logical defaults default/false, and app startup updated general__pid. All other recorded XML entries compare equal. No full preference/file no-change claim.
